title: AI Extraction Job Contract
description: Schema/type contract for a future AI-assisted extraction job. This is a contract only: no provider integration, no network calls, and no raw LLM output is treated as approved intelligence. Unreviewed output is never downstream-safe.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for the extraction job.

source_id.description: Identifier of the registered source this job extracts from.

snapshot_id.description: Optional identifier of the snapshot this job extracts from.

extraction_goal.description: What the extraction is meant to produce (e.g. ncm_tariff_lines).

model_provider.description: Optional placeholder for a future model provider. No provider is integrated in this layer.

model_name.description: Optional placeholder for a future model identifier.

input_reference.description: Local reference to the prepared input (e.g. a snapshot path or id). Not raw content.

output_schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema the extraction output must conform to.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the extraction job.

confidence.description: Optional self-reported confidence. Never a substitute for human review.

warnings.description: Optional warnings raised during preparation or extraction.

human_review_required.description: Must be true for extraction output that may affect classification/compliance.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether extraction output may back downstream-consumable artifacts. Defaults to false.

metadata.description: Optional extra metadata for local traceability.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the job record was created.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the job record was last updated.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this extraction job payload.
